name: LobeHub
description: A Chief Agent Operator (CAO) that builds, runs, and coordinates AI agent teams. Describe a goal, and it assembles the right agents/skills from 273K+ Skills and 51K+ MCP servers, runs tasks in parallel in the cloud using Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, and routes work across models. Reports back via existing channels (Slack/Discord/Telegram/iMessage/WeChat) with a daily brief instead of requiring constant tab-switching.
community_quotes: #2 Product of the Day with 325 upvotes
The 'one daily brief instead of 15 tabs' framing gets me - most agentic tools still make you babysit the process
Agents show up where you already chat — Slack, Discord, Telegram, WeChat, Feishu, Lark, LINE, QQ, iMessage
